name: Milwaukee Tool
verdict: MILWAUKEE is a brand of Techtronic Industries, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, where the Pudwill family is the largest shareholder and the remaining ownership is largely institutional. Nothing found.
note: Heavy-duty power-tool maker; joined the Alpine endurance project for 2026 per the club's 19/03/2026 release. Shareholding per TTI's 2026 interim report (claim techtronic-shareholders): the Pudwill family is the largest shareholder; the only substantial-shareholder entries are JPMorgan Chase, Bank of New York Mellon, Capital Group, BlackRock and Pandanus Associates (5-11% each, largely custody and lending positions), so no state or fund is in play.
